about.label: About Us
about.heading: A Commitment to Excellence in Healthcare
paragraphs: Known in the healthcare landscape as Shaivi Surgical and formally recognized as Dhrithi Surgical Solutions Private Limited, we represent unwavering trust and excellence in surgical solutions. Since our founding on November 8, 2017, we have dedicated ourselves to the highest standards of quality, developing innovative surgical disposables and protective products that empower healthcare professionals to deliver exceptional patient care.
At Dhrithi Surgical Solutions Private Limited, our mission is to be a reliable partner for healthcare providers by ensuring safety and sterility in every product we manufacture.
With a commitment to precision and integrity, we proudly support the vital work of healthcare professionals dedicated to improving lives.

gowns.heading: Gowns
intro: Experience the pinnacle of protection and comfort with our GOWNS. Crafted from a superior blend of SMS, SMMS, Spunlace, Spunbond, and non-woven fabrics, these gowns redefine surgical standards. Designed for maximum air permeability, they ensure you stay comfortable and focused during even the most prolonged operations.

Our gowns boast exceptional features: they are water-resistant, alcohol-repellent, liquid-repellent, and anti-static, all while remaining 100% breathable. Perfectly engineered for the rigours of surgery, they meet every demand with elegance and efficiency.
With soft knit cuffs that enhance comfort and extended length for seamless closed gloving, our surgical gowns are not just a choice—they’re a commitment to excellence in surgical care.

types.name: Standard Surgical Gowns
paragraphs: Our standard surgical gowns are constructed from premium materials such as SMS, SMMS, spunlace, spunbond, and non-woven fabric.
These gowns are designed to offer superior protection against microorganisms while delivering exceptional comfort through enhanced breathability.

Engineered for durability and performance, these gowns ensure excellent air and permeable protection, providing comfort and convenience even during lengthy surgical procedures. They feature water, alcohol, and liquid repellency, along with anti-static properties, making them ideal for various surgical settings. With 100% breathable fabric, our gowns are a reliable choice for any surgical team.

types.name: Patient Gowns
types.lead: Have you ever wondered why hospital gowns feel so light and comfortable, yet keep you protected?
paragraphs: Shaivi crafts its patient gowns from advanced materials like SMS, SMMS, spunlace, and spunbond non-woven fabrics. These fabrics aren’t just lightweight—they’re also highly breathable, allowing air to circulate freely to keep patients comfortable, even during extended hospital stays. Designed to shield against microorganisms, these gowns prioritise hygiene without sacrificing comfort. Plus, with 100% breathability, they help reduce skin irritation and support temperature control, making every patient’s experience safer and more comfortable.

types.name: Reinforced and BVB Surgical Gowns
paragraphs: These reinforced surgical gowns are crafted from top-quality, non-woven fabrics—BVB, SMS, SMMS, Spunlace, and Spunbond—to offer outstanding comfort and protection.

The key component, Breathable Viral Barrier (BVB) fabric, is a cutting-edge tri-laminate material with a breathable monolithic film that blocks infectious viruses like HIV/AIDS and SARS, while allowing airflow for all-day comfort.
Soft yet highly repellent fabric covers the gown’s front and sleeves, providing resistance to blood, alcohol, and other fluids. This ensures comfort and security, even during extended surgeries.

Reinforced zones on the chest and arms provide extra strength where it’s needed most, delivering both strikethrough protection and comfort for long procedures. Thoughtfully designed, these gowns support you with lasting protection and ease, so you can stay focused on what matters most.
